topic: Session creation and time zone rules
summary_markdown: The group discussed the mechanics of session tracking. It was confirmed that a new day always initiates a new session in production, or alternatively, sessions can be prevented from being created by looking at previous days. However, it was clarified that extending an existing session into a previous day is not possible. When referencing previous days for session analysis, the time zone standard must be UTC.
decisions: Previous day's data must be referenced using UTC.
